A1.justification: Both PDFs describe the same two-variant image-watermarking framework, renamed from MaskMark to MaskWM. Their text, equations, tables, figures, and complete appendices are readable and matchable.

before.justification: v2 reports original watermark extraction, localization, robustness, efficiency, and ablation results in Section 4 and Appendix D.

after.justification: v3 retains these original experiments, including the numerical comparisons, fine-tuning results, ablations, and qualitative examples.

M1.justification: Equation 1 changes the stated embedding rule from applying JND to the encoding residual to multiplying that residual by JND computed from the original image. This is a limited revision to the encoder formulation; architectures, masking, losses, and inference remain unchanged. The PDFs do not establish whether the implementation changed.

E1.justification: Both versions use MS-COCO 2014 for the same global/local watermarking, localization, and multiple-watermark tasks. Distortion scenarios, VAE attacks, and appendix inpainting/outpainting examples are retained.

E2.justification: The same seven baseline families and EditGuard-C/D variants remain in global/local comparisons. Localization still compares EditGuard and WAM, while multiple-watermark evaluation still compares WAM. Appendix comparator sets also match.

E3.justification: Sections 4.1–4.4 and Appendix C retain the training budget, resolutions, metrics, distortion parameters, and sampling procedures, including 1,000 global-evaluation images and 9,600 local image-mask pairs. No evaluation design is added or revised.

E4.justification: Section 4.5 and Appendix D retain the same visual-quality ablations, individual-distortion tests, bit-length analysis, VAE fine-tuning comparison, masking ablation, and localization case studies.

E5.justification: v3 checklist item 7 newly mentions multiple runs and fixed seeds/models, explaining omitted error bars through claimed negligible variance. Neither version provides numerical uncertainty estimates; v3 supplies no run count or seed values and does not establish an increase in runs.

E6.justification: Tables 1–2 and Figures 3–20 retain their numerical results, curves, rankings, and examples. The limited addition is checklist item 7's qualitative assertion of negligible PSNR, SSIM, and Bit Accuracy variance across multiple runs, without numerical estimates.

T1.justification: Equation 1 revises the mathematical definition of the watermarked image by introducing original-image JND weighting multiplied by the residual. The remaining equations and Algorithm 1 are unchanged; no theorem or proof is added.

C1.justification: After matching the renamed framework, the abstract, introduction, and conclusion retain the same claims about local embedding/extraction, localization, robustness, scalability, efficiency, and adaptability.

C2.justification: Checklist item 7 newly attributes negligible variance to deterministic evaluation with fixed seeds/models and argues that error bars would not affect interpretation or claim validity. Existing mechanism explanations, failure conditions, and Appendix A's visual-artifact limitations remain unchanged.

D1.justification: The repository pointer changes from MaskMark to MaskWM, and checklist item 5 newly states that code, data, and reproduction instructions are publicly available. Appendix C's implementation details remain unchanged. The PDFs alone do not verify the external resources.

R1.justification: The same 30 research references and substantive comparisons with prior watermarking approaches are retained. Citation punctuation changes and added checklist policy links do not alter research positioning.

P1.justification: v3 consistently renames MaskMark to MaskWM, updates contact and venue text, and adds acknowledgments and a NeurIPS checklist. The existing scientific narrative and appendix organization are otherwise retained.

P2.justification: Both tables and all 20 figures are retained. Method labels, legends, and captions reflect the rename, with minor reflow and end-matter layout changes from the acknowledgments and checklist. No scientific display is added or removed.

improvement.justification: The revised Equation 1 explicitly separates original-image JND weighting from the encoding residual, improving the specification for reproduction. New access and reporting disclosures provide limited transparency. Benchmark evidence remains unchanged, and the checklist's unquantified negligible-variance assertion does not strengthen statistical validation.
